references.text: Sarai was barren; she had no children.
Pharaoh gave Abram female servants when he was in Egypt – possibly including the Egyptian Hagar.
Abram says that he is childless and that Eliezer of Damascus will inherit him.
Rachel, who was also barren, gives Jacob her maidservant Bilhah as a wife to have children through her.
Paul uses the story of Sarah and Hagar allegorically to illustrate the difference between the old covenant and the new covenant.
